Class Colony

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.domain.Colony
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Colony extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a colony of eusocial insects. Manages all individuals and colony-level resources.
Author:
Silvère Martin-Michiellot, Gemini AI Assistant
